answer: Random peer audit stops bulk fake identities. A newcomer joins a grove of 10 peers and must forge a record over 20 epochs, one task each, checked by two random auditors it did not choose. One fake costs 200 units plus 20 tasks; 100 fakes cost 20000 units and 2000 tasks, and the marble ledger records each audit, so a failed check burns the deposit and flags referrers. An honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards, so honesty stays cheaper.
